description: This file defines comparison operators for AudioConfig and MediaSource structures within the firebolt::rialto namespace, used for media source configuration and media pipeline management.

methods.name: operator== (const AudioConfig &, const AudioConfig &)
methods.description: Compares two AudioConfig objects for equality based on number of channels, sample rate, and codec-specific configuration.

methods.name: operator== (const IMediaPipeline::MediaSource &, const IMediaPipeline::MediaSource &)
methods.description: Compares two MediaSource objects for equality based on their ID, type, and MIME type.
